name: Hawking soul
description: a damned soul of the Ember Wastes, stuck in Hell's loop forever: a thin hunched bald human figure in a long ragged ash-grey shroud, pale ash-grey skin, hollow tired eyes, a soft pale blue-white glow around its outline, bare feet, holding a shallow tray of glowing cinders against its belly on a frayed strap, mouth open mid-call

poses.stand: standing hunched, the tray of glowing cinders held against its belly

idle.action: rocks gently in place, breathing slowly

hiccup.action: calls out, tray bobbing, then slumps and calls again
